integrity.computational_scope: All 25 splits, 105 compatible pairs, 105 compatible triples, and all 11025 entries of their incidence matrix.
integrity.proof_certificate: 1948 unimodular integer operations, replayable using the included standard-library checker.

scientific_limitations: This is an integral incidence computation in free groups of formal boundary strata, not a Chow-group or homology computation.
The group action on the cokernel is not decomposed; no result for other marking numbers is asserted.
An unindexed earlier calculation of the same unsigned incidence matrix remains possible.
title: Nine integral parity obstructions in the six-pointed stable-curve boundary
